SERVING
SIZE:
1/2 cup, baked (68 g)
Yam
Family Dioscoreaceae
Scientific name Dioscorea alata
Common name yam
♥A good source of vitamin C, fiber, and
potassium
cool, dry, dark place but should not be
refrigerated.  Because they grow under-
ground, they should be scrubbed well to
remove any clinging soil.  Yams must be
cooked before eating. Like potatoes, they
can be baked, boiled, fried, or micro-
waved.  They can be substituted for sweet
potatoes, cut into chunks or mashed and
seasoned with apple juice, orange peel,
or sweet spices.  They also are a flavorful
addition to soups, casseroles, and stews
and can take the place of mashed pumpkin
in pies, cakes, and pastries.
Nutrient composition
Yams are a good source of vitamin C and
dietary fiber and are high in potassium.
